name: looprch
description: Orchestrates coding agents phase by phase from a SEV3 project specification.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-concurrency=4 "build/test/unit/**/*.test.js" "build/test/integration/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-concurrency=2 "build/test/e2e/**/*.test.js"
